morceaux.1:
<head type="main">P. OVIDI NASONIS FASTORVM LIBER QVARTVS</head>

<lg type="strophe">
<l n="1">Adspice curvatos pomorum pondere ramos,</l>
<l n="2">ut sua, quod peperit, vix ferat arbor onus.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Alma, fave', dixi 'geminorum mater <name type="deity">Amorum</name>';</l>
  <l n="2">ad vatem voltus rettulit illa suos;</l>
  <l n="3"><quote>'quid tibi'</quote> ait 'mecum? certe maiora canebas.</l>
  <l n="4">num vetus in molli pectore volnus habes?'</l>
  <l n="5">'scis, dea', respondi 'de volnere.' risit, et aether</l>
  <l n="6">protinus ex illa parte serenus erat.</l>
  <l n="7">'saucius an sanus numquid tua signa reliqui?</l>
  <l n="8">tu mihi propositum, tu mihi semper opus.</l>
  <l n="9">quae decuit primis sine crimine lusimus annis;</l>
  <l n="10">nunc teritur nostris area maior <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">tempora cum causis, annalibus eruta priscis,</l>
  <l n="12">lapsaque sub terras ortaque signa cano.</l>
  <l n="13">venimus ad quartum, quo tu celeberrima mense:</l>
  <l n="14">et vatem et mensem scis, <name type="deity">Venus</name>, esse tuos.'</l>
  <l n="15">mota <placeName>Cytheriaca</placeName> leviter mea tempora <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">myrto</name></l>
  <l n="16">contigit et 'coeptum perfice' dixit 'opus'.</l>
  <l n="17">sensimus, et causae subito patuere dierum:</l>
  <l n="18">dum licet et spirant flamina, navis eat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">Si<foreign xml:lang="la">qua</foreign> tamen pars te de fastis tangere debet,</l>
  <l n="20"><persName>Caesar</persName>, in Aprili quod tuearis habes:</l>
  <l n="21">hic ad te magna descendit imagine mensis,</l>
  <l n="22">et fit adoptiva nobilitate tuus.</l>
  <l n="23">hoc pater <foreign xml:lang="la">Iliades</foreign>, cum longum scriberet annum,</l>
  <l n="24">vidit et auctores rettulit ipse tuos:</l>
  <l n="25">utque fero <name type="deity">Martis</name> primam dedit ordine sortem,</l>
  <l n="26">quod sibi nascendi proxima causa fuit,</l>
  <l n="27">sic <name type="deity">Venerem</name> gradibus multis in gente receptam</l>
  <l n="28">alterius voluit mensis habere locum;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">principiumque sui generis revolutaque quaerens</l>
  <l n="30">saecula, cognatos venit adusque deos.</l>
  <l n="31"><persName>Dardanon</persName> <name type="deity">Electra</name> nesciret <foreign xml:lang="la">Atlantide</foreign> natum</l>
  <l n="32"><quote>scilicet, <name type="deity">Electran</name> concubuisse <name type="deity">Iovi</name>?</quote></l>
</lg>
morceaux.3: huius Ericthonius, Tros est generatus ab illo, Assaracon creat hic, Assaracusque Capyn; proximus Anchises, cum quo commune parentis non dedignata est nomen habere Venus: hinc satus Aeneas; pietas spectata per ignes sacra patremque umeris, altera sacra, tulit. venimus ad felix aliquando nomen Iuli, unde domus Teucros Iulia tangit avos. Postumus hinc, qui, quod silvis fuit ortus in altis, Silvius in Latia gente vocatus erat. isque, Latine, tibi pater est; subit Alba Latinum; proximus est titulis Epytus, Alba, tuis. ille dedit Capyi repetita vocabula Troiae et tuus est idem, Calpete, factus avus. cumque patris regnum post hunc Tiberinus haberet, dicitur in Tuscae gurgite mersus aquae. iam tamen Agrippam natum Remulumque nepotem viderat; in Remulum fulmina missa ferunt. venit Aventinus post hos, locus unde vocatur, mons quoque; post illum tradita regna Procae; quem sequitur duri Numitor germanus Amuli; Ilia cum Lauso de Numitore sati: ense cadit patrui Lausus; placet Ilia Marti, teque parit, gemino iuncte Quirine Remo. ille suos semper Venerem Martemque parentes dixit, et emeruit vocis habere fidem: neve secuturi possent nescire nepotes, tempora dis generis continuata dedit. sed Veneris mensem Γραικῷ sermone notatum auguror; a spumis est dea dicta maris. nec tibi sit mirum Γραικῷ rem nomine dici; Itala nam tellus Γραικία maior erat.
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="65">venerat <persName>Euander</persName> plena cum classe suorum,</l>
  <l n="66">venerat <persName>Alcides</persName>, <foreign xml:lang="grc">Graius</foreign> uterque genus</l>
  <l n="67">(<persName>hospes</persName> <placeName>Aventinis</placeName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">armentum</name> pavit in <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbis</name></l>
  <l n="68"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">claviger</name>, et tanto est <placeName>Albula</placeName> pota deo),</l>
  <l n="69">dux quoque <persName>Neritius</persName>; testes <placeName>Laestrygones</placeName> exstant</l>
  <l n="70">et quod adhuc <persName>Circes</persName> <name type="place" xml:lang="la">nominis</name> <placeName>litus</placeName> habet;</l>
  <l n="71">et iam <persName>Telegoni</persName>, iam moenia <placeName>Tiburis</placeName> udi</l>
  <l n="72">stabant, <persName>Argolicae</persName> quod posuere manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="73">venerat <persName>Atridae</persName> fatis agitatus <persName>Halaesus</persName>,</l>
  <l n="74">a quo se dictam terra <placeName>Falisca</placeName> putat.</l>
  <l n="75">adice <persName>Trojanae</persName> suasorem <persName>Antenora</persName> pacis,</l>
  <l n="76">et generum <persName>Oeniden</persName>, <persName>Apule</persName> <persName>Daune</persName>, tuum.</l>
  <l n="77">serus ab <placeName>Iliacis</placeName>, et post <persName>Antenora</persName>, flammis</l>
  <l n="78">attulit <persName>Aeneas</persName> in loca nostra deos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="79">huius erat <persName>Solimus</persName> <name type="place" xml:lang="la">Phrygia</name> comes unus ab <placeName>Ida</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="80">a quo <placeName>Sulmonis</placeName> moenia <name type="place" xml:lang="la">nomen</name> habent,</l>
  <l n="81"><placeName>Sulmonis</placeName> gelidi, patriae, <persName>Germanice</persName>, nostrae.</l>
  <l n="82">me miserum, <name type="place" xml:lang="la">Scythico</name> quam procul illa <name type="place" xml:lang="la">solo</name> est!</l>
  <l n="83">ergo ego tam longe -- sed supprime, <persName>Musa</persName>, querellas:</l>
  <l n="84">non tibi sunt maesta sacra canenda <foreign xml:lang="la">lyra</foreign>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="85">Quo non <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">livor</name> abit? sunt qui tibi mensis honorem</l>
  <l n="86">eripuisse velint invideantque, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name>.</l>
  <l n="87">nam, quia ver <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">aperit</name> tunc omnia densaque cedit</l>
  <l n="88"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">frigoris</name> asperitas fetaque terra patet,</l>
  <l n="89"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Aprilis</name> memorant ab aperto tempore dictum,</l>
  <l n="90">quem <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name> iniecta vindicat alma manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="91">illa quidem totum dignissima temperat orbem,</l>
  <l n="92">illa tenet nullo regna minora deo,</l>
  <l n="93">iuraque dat caelo, terrae, natalibus undis,</l>
  <l n="94">perque suos initus continet omne genus.</l>
  <l n="95">illa deos omnes (longum est numerare) creavit,</l>
  <l n="96">illa satis causas arboribusque dedit,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="97">illa <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">rudes</name> animos hominum contraxit in unum,</l>
  <l n="98">et docuit iungi cum pare quemque sua.</l>
  <l n="99">quid genus omne creat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volucrum</name>, nisi blanda voluptas?</l>
  <l n="100">nec coeant <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecudes</name>, si levis absit amor.</l>
  <l n="101">cum mare trux <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aries</name> cornu decertat, at idem</l>
  <l n="102">frontem dilectae laedere parcit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovis</name>;</l>
  <l n="103">deposita sequitur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurus</name> feritate iuvencam,</l>
  <l n="104">quem toti saltus, quem nemus omne tremit;</l>
  <l n="105">vis eadem lato quodcumque sub aequore vivit</l>
  <l n="106">servat, et innumeris <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">piscibus</name> implet aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="107">prima feros habitus homini detraxit: ab illa</l>
  <l n="108">venerunt cultus mundaque cura sui.</l>
  <l n="109">primus amans carmen vigilatum nocte negata</l>
  <l n="110">dicitur ad clausas concinuisse fores,</l>
  <l n="111">eloquiumque fuit duram exorare puellam,</l>
  <l n="112">proque sua causa quisque disertus erat.</l>
  <l n="113">mille per hanc artes motae; studioque placendi,</l>
  <l n="114">quae latuere prius, multa reperta ferunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="115">hanc quisquam titulo mensis spoliare secundi</l>
  <l n="116">audeat? a nobis sit furor iste procul.</l>
  <l n="117">quid quod ubique potens templisque frequentibus aucta,</l>
  <l n="118">urbe tamen nostra ius dea maius habet?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="119">pro <placeName>Troia</placeName>, <persName>Romane</persName>, <name type="deity">Venus</name> arma ferebat,</l>
  <l n="120">cum gemuit teneram cuspide laesa manum;</l>
  <l n="121"><name type="deity">caelestes</name>que duas <placeName>Troiano</placeName> iudice vicit</l>
  <l n="122">(ah nolim victas hoc meminisse deas),</l>
  <l n="123"><name type="deity">Assaracique</name> nurus dicta est, ut scilicet olim</l>
  <l n="124">magnus <persName>Iuleos</persName> <persName>Caesar</persName> haberet avos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="125">nec <name type="deity">Veneri</name> tempus, quam ver, erat aptius ullum</l>
  <l n="126">(vere nitent terrae, vere remissus ager;</l>
  <l n="127">nunc herbae rupta tellure cacumina tollunt,</l>
  <l n="128">nunc tumido gemmas cortice palmes agit),</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
et Venus formosa formoso tempore digna est, utque solet, Marti continuata suo est. vere monet curvas materna per aequora puppes ire nec hibernas iam timuisse minas.

morceaux.7:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="133">Rite deam colitis, Latiae matresque nurusque</l>
  <l n="134">et vos, quis vittae longaque vestis abest.</l>
  <l n="135">aurea marmoreo redimicula demite collo,</l>
  <l n="136">demite divitias: tota lavanda dea est.</l>
  <l n="137">aurea siccato redimicula reddite collo:</l>
  <l n="138">nunc alii flores, nunc nova danda rosa est.</l>
  <l n="139">vos quoque sub viridi <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">myrto</name> iubet ipsa lavari:</l>
  <l n="140">causaque cur iubeat, discite, certa subest.</l>
  <l n="141">litore siccabat rorantes nuda capillos:</l>
  <l n="142">viderunt satyri, turba proterva, deam.</l>
  <l n="13">sensit et opposita texit sua corpora <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">myrto</name>:</l>
  <l n="144">tuta fuit facto, vosque referre iubet.</l>
  <l n="145">discite nunc, quare <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fortunae</name> tura <persName>Virili</persName></l>
  <l n="146">detis eo, gelida qui locus umet aqua.</l>
  <l n="147">accipit ille locus posito velamine cunctas</l>
  <l n="148">et vitium nudi corporis omne videt;</l>
  <l n="149">ut tegat hoc celetque viros, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fortuna Virilis</name></l>
  <l n="150">praestat et hoc parvo ture rogata facit.</l>
  <l n="151">nec pigeat tritum niveo cum lacte <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">papaver</name></l>
  <l n="152">sumere et expressis mella liquata favis:</l>
  <l n="153">cum primum cupido <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name> est deducta marito,</l>
  <l n="154">hoc bibit; ex illo tempore nupta fuit.</l>
  <l n="155">supplicibus verbis illam placate: sub illa</l>
  <l n="156">et forma et mores et bona fama manet.</l>
  <l n="157"><placeName>Roma</placeName> pudicitia proavorum tempore lapsa est:</l>
  <l n="158"><placeName>Cumaeam</placeName>, veteres, consuluistis anum.</l>
  <l n="159">templa iubet fieri <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Veneri</name>: quibus ordine factis</l>
  <l n="160">inde <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name> verso nomina corde tenet.</l>
  <l n="161">semper ad <persName>Aeneadas</persName> placido, pulcherrima, voltu</l>
  <l n="162">respice, totque tuas, diva, tuere nurus.</l>
  <l n="163">Dum loquor, elatae metuendus acumine caudae</l>
  <l n="164"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Scorpios</name> in virides praecipitatur aquas.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.8:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Nox ubi transierit, caelumque rubescere primo</l>
  <l n="2">coeperit, et tactae rore querentur aves,</l>
  <l n="3">semustamque facem vigilata nocte viator</l>
  <l n="4">ponet, et ad solitum rusticus ibit opus,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Pliades incipient umeros relevare paternos,</l>
  <l n="6"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Pliades</name> quae septem dici, sex tamen esse solent:</l>
  <l n="7">seu quod in amplexum sex hinc venere deorum</l>
  <l n="8">(nam <persName>Steropen</persName> <name type="deity">Marti</name> concubuisse ferunt,</l>
  <l n="9"><name type="deity">Neptuno</name> <persName>Alcyonen</persName> et te, formosa <persName>Celaeno</persName>,</l>
  <l n="10"><persName>Maian</persName> et <persName>Electran</persName> <persName>Taygetenque</persName> <name type="deity">Iovi</name>),</l>
  <l n="11">septima mortali <persName>Merope</persName> tibi, <persName>Sisyphe</persName>, nupsit;</l>
  <l n="12">paenitet, et facti sola pudore latet:</l>
  <l n="13">sive quod <persName>Electra</persName> <placeName>Troiae</placeName> spectare ruinas</l>
  <l n="14">non tulit, ante oculos opposuitque manum.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.9:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Ter sine perpetuo caelum versetur in axe,</l>
  <l n="2">ter iungat Titan terque resolvat equos,</l>
  <l n="3">protinus inflexo Berecyntia tibia cornu</l>
  <l n="4">flabit, et Idaeae festa parentis erunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">ibunt semimares et inania tympana tundent,</l>
  <l n="6">aeraque tinnitus aere repulsa dabunt;</l>
  <l n="7">ipsa sedens molli comitum cervice feretur</l>
  <l n="8">Urbis per medias exululata vias.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">scaena sonat, ludique vocant: spectate, <persName>Quirites</persName>,</l>
  <l n="10">et fora Marte suo litigiosa vacent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">quaerere multa libet, sed me sonus aeris acuti</l>
  <l n="12">terret et horrendo <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lotos</name> adunca sono.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">'da, dea, quam sciter.' doctas Cybeleia neptes</l>
  <l n="14">vidit et has curae iussit adesse meae.</l>
  <l n="15">'pandite mandati memores, Heliconis alumnae,</l>
  <l n="16">gaudeat assiduo cur dea Magna sono.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">sic ego. sic <persName>Erato</persName> (mensis <foreign xml:lang="la">Cythereius</foreign> illi</l>
  <l n="18">cessit, quod teneri nomen amoris habet):</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">'reddita <name type="deity">Saturno</name> sors haec erat: "optime regum,</l>
  <l n="20">a nato sceptris excutiere tuis."</l>
  <l n="21">ille suam metuens, ut quaeque erat edita, prolem</l>
  <l n="22">devorat, immersam visceribusque tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">saepe <persName>Rhea</persName> questa est totiens fecunda nec umquam</l>
  <l n="24">mater, et indoluit fertilitate sua.</l>
  <l n="25"><name type="deity">Iuppiter</name> ortus erat: (pro magno teste vetustas</l>
  <l n="26">creditur; acceptam parce movere fidem)</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">veste latens saxum caelesti gutture sedit:</l>
  <l n="28">sic genitor fatis decipiendus erat.</l>
  <l n="29">ardua iamdudum resonat tinnitibus <placeName>Ide</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="30">tutus ut infanti vagiat ore puer.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">pars clipeos sudibus, galeas pars tundit inanes:</l>
  <l n="32">hoc Curetes habent, hoc Corybantes opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">res latuit, priscique manent imitamina facti:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.10:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="210">aera deae comites raucaque terga movent.</l>
  <l n="211">cymbala pro galeis, pro scutis tympana pulsant:</l>
  <l n="212">tibia dat Phrygios, ut dedit ante, modos.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="213">desierat; coepi: 'cur huic genus acre <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leonum</name></l>
  <l n="214">praebent insolitas ad iuga curva iubas?'</l>
  <l n="215">desieram; coepit: 'feritas mollita per illam</l>
  <l n="216">creditur; id curru testificata suo est.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="217">'at cur turrifera caput est onerata corona?</l>
  <l n="218">an primis turres urbibus illa dedit?'</l>
  <l n="219">adnuit. 'unde venit' dixi 'sua membra secandi</l>
  <l n="220">impetus?' ut tacui, Pieris orsa loqui:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="221">'Phryx puer in silvis, facie spectabilis, Attis</l>
  <l n="222">turrigeram casto vinxit amore <name type="deity">deam</name>;</l>
  <l n="223">hunc sibi servari voluit, sua templa tueri,</l>
  <l n="224">et dixit "semper fac puer esse velis."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="225">ille fidem iussis dedit, et "si mentiar", inquit</l>
  <l n="226">"ultima, qua fallam, sit Venus illa mihi."</l>
  <l n="227">fallit, et in nympha Sagaritide desinit esse</l>
  <l n="228">quod fuit: hinc poenas exigit ira <name type="deity">deae</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="229">Naida volneribus succidit in arbore factis,</l>
  <l n="230">illa perit; fatum Naidos arbor erat;</l>
  <l n="231">hic furit, et credens thalami procumbere tectum</l>
  <l n="232">effugit, et cursu Dindyma summa petit;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="233">et modo "tolle faces", "remove" modo "verbera" clamat,</l>
  <l n="234">saepe <foreign xml:lang="la">Palaestinas</foreign> iurat adesse deas.</l>
  <l n="235">ille etiam saxo corpus laniavit acuto,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="236">longaque in immundo pulvere tracta coma est,</l>
  <l n="237">voxque fuit "merui: meritas do sanguine poenas.</l>
  <l n="238">ah pereant partes quae nocuere mihi!"</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="239">"ah pereant" dicebat adhuc; onus inguinis aufert,</l>
  <l n="240">nullaque sunt subito signa relicta viri.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.11:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="241">venit in exemplum furor hic, mollesque ministri</l>
  <l n="242">caedunt iactatis vilia membra comis.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="243">talibus Aoniae facunda voce Camenae</l>
  <l n="244">reddita quaesiti causa furoris erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="245">'hoc quoque, dux operis, moneas precor, unde petita</l>
  <l n="246">venerit; an nostra semper in urbe fuit?'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="247">'Dindymon et <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Cybelen</name> et amoenam fontibus <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Iden</name></l>
  <l n="248">semper et <name type="deity">Iliacas</name> <name type="deity">Mater</name> amavit opes:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="249">cum <persName>Troiam</persName> <persName>Aeneas</persName> Italos portaret in agros,</l>
  <l n="250">est dea sacriferas paene secuta rates,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="251">sed nondum fatis <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Latio</name> sua numina posci</l>
  <l n="252">senserat, adsuetis substiteratque locis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="243">post, ut <placeName>Roma</placeName> potens opibus iam saecula quinque</l>
  <l n="254">vidit et edomito sustulit orbe caput,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="255">carminis <foreign xml:lang="grc">Euboici</foreign> fatalia verba sacerdos</l>
  <l n="256">inspicit; inspectum tale fuisse ferunt:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="257">"mater abest: matrem iubeo, <placeName>Romane</placeName>, requiras.</l>
  <l n="258">cum veniet, casta est accipienda manu."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="259">obscurae sortis patres ambagibus errant,</l>
  <l n="260">quaeve parens absit, quove petenda loco.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="261">consulitur <name type="deity">Paean</name>, "divum" que "arcessite Matrem"</l>
  <l n="262">inquit; "in <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Idaeo</name> est invenienda iugo."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="263">mittuntur proceres. <placeName>Phrygiae</placeName> tum sceptra tenebat</l>
  <l n="264"><persName>Attalus</persName>; Ausoniis rem negat ille viris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="265">mira canam: longo tremuit cum murmure tellus,</l>
  <l n="266">et sic est adytis diva locuta suis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="267">"ipsa peti volui: ne sit mora; mitte volentem:</l>
  <l n="268">dignus <placeName>Roma</placeName> locus quo deus omnis eat."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="269">ille soni terrore pavens "proficiscere" dixit;</l>
  <l n="270">"nostra eris: in <placeName>Phrygios</placeName> <placeName>Roma</placeName> refertur avos."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="271">protinus innumerae caedunt pineta secures</l>
  <l n="272">illa, quibus fugiens <persName>Phryx</persName> pius usus erat.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.12:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="275">mille manus coeunt, et picta coloribus ustis</l>
  <l n="276"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">caelestum</name> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Matrem</name> concava puppis habet.</l>
  <l n="277">illa sui per <foreign xml:lang="la">aquas</foreign> fertur tutissima nati,</l>
  <l n="278">longaque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Phrixeae</name> stagna sororis adit,</l>
  <l n="279"><name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Rhoeteum</name>que capax <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Sigeaque</name> litora transit,</l>
  <l n="280">et <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Tenedum</name> et veteres <persName>Eetionis</persName> opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="281"><name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Cyclades</name> excipiunt, <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Lesbo</name> post terga relicta,</l>
  <l n="282">quaeque <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Carysteis</name> frangitur unda vadis;</l>
  <l n="283">transit et <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Icarium</name>, lapsas ubi perdidit alas</l>
  <l n="284"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Icarus</name>, et vastae nomina fecit <foreign xml:lang="la">aquae</foreign>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="285">tum laeva <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Creten</name>, dextra <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Pelopeidas</name> undas</l>
  <l n="286">deserit, et <name type="deity">Veneris</name> sacra <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Cythera</name> petit.</l>
  <l n="287">hinc mare <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Trinacrium</name>, candens ubi tinguere ferrum</l>
  <l n="288"><name type="deity">Brontes</name> et <name type="deity">Steropes</name> <name type="deity">Acmonides</name>que solent,</l>
  <l n="289">aequoraque <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Afra</name> legit, <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Sardoaque</name> regna sinistris</l>
  <l n="290">respicit a remis, <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Ausoniam</name>que tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="291">ostia contigerat, qua se <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Tiberinus</name> in altum</l>
  <l n="292">dividit et campo liberiore natat:</l>
  <l n="293">omnis eques mixtaque gravis cum plebe senatus</l>
  <l n="294">obvius ad <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Tusci</name> fluminis ora venit.</l>
  <l n="295">procedunt pariter matres nataeque nurusque</l>
  <l n="296">quaeque colunt sanctos <foreign xml:lang="la">virginitate</foreign> focos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="297">sedula fune viri contento bracchia lassant:</l>
  <l n="298">vix subit adversas hospita navis <foreign xml:lang="la">aquas</foreign>.</l>
  <l n="299">sicca diu fuerat tellus, sitis usserat <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbas</name>:</l>
  <l n="300">sedit limoso pressa carina vado.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="301">quisquis adest operi, plus quam pro parte laborat,</l>
  <l n="302">adiuvat et fortes voce sonante manus:</l>
  <l n="303">illa velut medio stabilis sedet insula ponto;</l>
  <l n="304">attoniti monstro stantque paventque viri.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="305"><persName>Claudia Quinta</persName> genus <persName>Clauso</persName> referebat ab alto</l>
  <l n="306">(nec facies impar nobilitate fuit),</l>
</lg>
morceaux.13:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="307">casta quidem, sed non et credita: rumor iniquus</l>
  <l n="308">laeserat, et falsi criminis acta rea est.</l>
  <l n="309">cultus et ornatis varie prodisse capillis</l>
  <l n="310">obfuit ad rigidos promptaque lingua senes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="311">conscia mens recti famae mendacia risit,</l>
  <l n="312">sed nos in vitium credula turba sumus.</l>
  <l n="313">haec ubi castarum processit ab agmine matrum</l>
  <l n="314">et manibus puram fluminis hausit aquam,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="315">ter caput inrorat, ter tollit in aethera palmas</l>
  <l n="316">(quicumque aspiciunt, mente carere putant),</l>
  <l n="317">summissoque genu voltus in imagine divae</l>
  <l n="318">figit, et hos edit crine iacente sonos:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="319">"supplicis, alma, tuae, genetrix fecunda deorum,</l>
  <l n="320">accipe sub certa condicione preces.</l>
  <l n="321">casta negor: si tu damnas, meruisse fatebor;</l>
  <l n="322">morte luam poenas iudice victa dea;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="323">sed si crimen abest, tu nostrae pignora vitae</l>
  <l n="324">re dabis, et castas casta sequere manus."</l>
  <l n="325">dixit, et exiguo funem conamine traxit;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="326">mira, sed et scaena testificata loquar:</l>
  <l n="327">mota dea est, sequiturque ducem laudatque sequendo;</l>
  <l n="328">index laetitiae fertur ad astra sonus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="329">fluminis ad flexum veniunt (Tiberina priores</l>
  <l n="330">Atria dixerunt), unde sinister abit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="331">nox aderat: querno religant in stipite funem,</l>
  <l n="332">dantque levi somno corpora functa cibo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="333">lux aderat: querno solvunt a stipite funem,</l>
  <l n="334">ante tamen posito tura dedere foco,</l>
  <l n="335">ante coronarunt puppem, sine labe iuvencam</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="336">mactarunt operum coniugiique rudem.</l>
  <l n="337">est locus, in Tiberim qua lubricus influit Almo</l>
  <l n="338">et nomen magno perdit in amne minor.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.14:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="340">illic purpurea <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canus</name> cum veste sacerdos</l>
  <l n="341"><placeName>Almonis</placeName> dominam sacraque lavit aquis.</l>
  <l n="342">exululant comites, furiosaque tibia flatur,</l>
  <l n="343">et feriunt molles taurea terga manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="344"><persName>Claudia</persName> praecedit laeto celeberrima voltu,</l>
  <l n="345">credita vix tandem teste pudica dea;</l>
  <l n="346">ipsa sedens plaustro porta est invecta <placeName>Capena</placeName>:</l>
  <l n="347">sparguntur iunctae flore recente boves.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="348"><persName>Nasica</persName> accepit; templi non perstitit auctor:</l>
  <l n="349"><persName>Augustus</persName> nunc est, ante <persName>Metellus</persName> erat.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="350">substitit hic <name type="deity">Erato</name>. mora fit, si cetera quaeram.</l>
  <l n="351">'dic' inquam 'parva cur stipe quaerat opes.'</l>
  <l n="352">'contulit aes populus, de quo delubra <persName>Metellus</persName></l>
  <l n="353">fecit' ait; 'dandae mos stipis inde manet.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="354">cur vicibus factis ineant convivia, quaero,</l>
  <l n="355">tum magis indictas concelebrentque dapes.</l>
  <l n="356">'quod bene mutarit sedem <name type="deity">Berecyntia</name>', dixit</l>
  <l n="357">captant mutatis sedibus omen idem.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="358">institeram, quare primi <name type="deity">Megalesia</name> ludi</l>
  <l n="359">urbe forent nostra, cum dea (sensit enim)</l>
  <l n="360">'illa deos' inquit 'peperit: cessere parenti,</l>
  <l n="361">principiumque dati <name type="deity">Mater</name> honoris habet.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="362">'cur igitur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Gallos</name> qui se excidere vocamus,</l>
  <l n="363">cum tanto a <placeName>Phrygia</placeName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Gallica</name> distet humus?'</l>
  <l n="364">'inter' ait 'viridem <name type="deity">Cybelen</name> altasque <placeName>Celaenas</placeName></l>
  <l n="365">amnis it insana, nomine <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Gallus</name>, aqua.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="366">qui bibit inde, furit: procul hinc discedite, quis est</l>
  <l n="367">cura bonae mentis: qui bibit inde, furit.'</l>
  <l n="368">'non pudet herbosum' dixi 'posuisse <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">moretum</name></l>
  <l n="369">in dominae mensis: an sua causa subest?'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="370">'lacte mero veteres usi narrantur et herbis,</l>
  <l n="371">sponte sua siquas terra ferebat' ait;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.15:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="365">candidus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">elisae</name> miscetur <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">caseus</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbae</name>,</l>
  <l n="366">cognoscat priscos ut <name type="deity">dea</name> prisca <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cibos</name>.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="367">Postera cum <placeName>caelo</placeName> motis <name type="deity">Pallantias</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">astris</name></l>
  <l n="368">fulserit, et niveos <name type="deity">Luna</name> levarit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>,</l>
  <l n="375">qui dicet 'quondam sacrata est colle <persName>Quirini</persName></l>
  <l n="376"><name type="deity">Fortuna</name> die Publica', verus erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="377">Tertia lux (memini) ludis erat, ac mihi quidam</l>
  <l n="378">spectanti senior continuusque loco</l>
  <l n="379">'haec' ait 'illa dies, <placeName>Libycis</placeName> qua <persName>Caesar</persName> in oris</l>
  <l n="380">perfida magnanimi contudit arma <persName>Iubae</persName>.</l>
  <l n="381">dux mihi <persName>Caesar</persName> erat, sub quo meruisse tribunus</l>
  <l n="382">glorior: officio praefuit ille meo.</l>
  <l n="383">hanc ego militia sedem, tu pace parasti,</l>
  <l n="384">inter bis quinos usus honore viros.'</l>
  <l n="385">plura locuturi subito seducimur imbre:</l>
  <l n="386">pendula caelestes <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Libra</name> movebat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquas</name>.</l>
  <l n="387">Ante tamen quam summa dies spectacula sistat</l>
  <l n="388"><name type="deity">ensifer</name> <name type="deity">Orion</name> aequore mersus erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="389">Proxima victricem cum <placeName>Romam</placeName> inspexerit <name type="deity">Eos</name></l>
  <l n="390">et dederit <persName>Phoebo</persName> stella fugata locum,</l>
  <l n="391"><placeName>Circus</placeName> erit pompa celeber numeroque deorum,</l>
  <l n="392">primaque ventosis palma petetur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.16:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="391">Hinc <name type="deity">Cereris</name> ludi: non est opus indice causae;</l>
  <l n="392">sponte deae munus promeritumque patet.</l>
  <l n="393"><foreign xml:lang="la">panis</foreign> erat primis virides mortalibus <name type="plant">herbae</name>,</l>
  <l n="394">quas <name type="placeName">tellus</name> nullo sollicitante dabat;</l>
  <l n="395">et modo carpebant vivax e <foreign xml:lang="la">caespite</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">gramen</foreign>,</l>
  <l n="396">nunc epulae tenera <foreign xml:lang="la">fronde</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">cacumen</foreign> erant.</l>
  <l n="397">postmodo <name type="plant">glans</name> nota est: bene erat iam <name type="plant">glande</name> reperta,</l>
  <l n="398">duraque magnificas <name type="plant">quercus</name> habebat opes.</l>
  <l n="399">prima <name type="deity">Ceres</name> <persName>homine</persName> ad meliora alimenta vocato</l>
  <l n="400">mutavit <name type="plant">glandes</name> utiliore <foreign xml:lang="la">cibo</foreign>.</l>
  <l n="401">illa iugo <name type="animal">tauros</name> collum praebere coegit:</l>
  <l n="402">tum primum <persName>soles</persName> eruta vidit <name type="placeName">humus</name>.</l>
  <l n="403"><foreign xml:lang="la">aes</foreign> erat in pretio, <persName>Chalybeia</persName> massa latebat:</l>
  <l n="404">eheu, perpetuo debuit illa tegi.</l>
  <l n="405">pace <name type="deity">Ceres</name> laeta est; et vos orate, <persName>coloni</persName>,</l>
  <l n="406">perpetuam pacem pacificumque ducem.</l>
  <l n="407"><foreign xml:lang="la">farra</foreign> <name type="deity">deae</name> <foreign xml:lang="la">micaeque</foreign> salientis honorem</l>
  <l n="408">detis et in veteres <foreign xml:lang="la">turea</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">grana</foreign> focos;</l>
  <l n="409">et, si <foreign xml:lang="la">tura</foreign> aberunt, unctas accendite <foreign xml:lang="la">taedas</foreign>:</l>
  <l n="410">parva bonae <name type="deity">Cereri</name>, sint modo casta, placent.</l>
  <l n="411">a <name type="animal">bove</name> succincti cultros removete ministri:</l>
  <l n="412"><name type="animal">bos</name> aret; ignavam sacrificate <name type="animal">suem</name>.</l>
  <l n="413">apta iugo <name type="animal">cervix</name> non est ferienda <foreign xml:lang="la">securi</foreign>:</l>
  <l n="414">vivat et in dura saepe laboret <name type="placeName">humo</name>.</l>
  <l n="415">Exigit ipse <name type="placeName">locus</name> raptus ut <persName>virginis</persName> edam:</l>
  <l n="416">plura recognosces, pauca docendus eris.</l>
  <l n="417">terra tribus <name type="animal">scopulis</name> vastum procurrit in <name type="placeName">aequor</name></l>
  <l n="418"><name type="placeName">Trinacris</name>, a positu nomen adepta <persName>loci</persName>,</l>
  <l n="419"><foreign xml:lang="la">grata</foreign> <name type="placeName">domus</name> <name type="deity">Cereri</name>: multas ea possidet <persName>urbes</persName>,</l>
  <l n="420">in quibus est culto fertilis <foreign xml:lang="la">Henna</foreign> <name type="placeName">solo</name>.</l>
  <l n="421">frigida <foreign xml:lang="la">caelestum</foreign> <persName>matres</persName> <persName>Arethusa</persName> vocarat:</l>
  <l n="422">venerat ad sacras et <name type="deity">dea</name> flava <foreign xml:lang="la">dapes</foreign>.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.17:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="425"> filia, consuetis ut erat comitata <name type="deity">puellis</name>,</l>
  <l n="426"> errabat nudo per sua prata pede.</l>
  <l n="427"> valle sub umbrosa locus est aspergine multa</l>
  <l n="428"> uvidus ex alto desilientis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>.</l>
  <l n="429"> tot fuerant illic, quot habet <foreign xml:lang="la">natura</foreign>, colores,</l>
  <l n="430"> pictaque dissimili flore nitebat humus.</l>
  <l n="431"> quam simul aspexit, 'comites, accedite' dixit</l>
  <l n="432"> 'et mecum plenos flore referte sinus.'</l>
  <l n="433"> praeda puellares animos prolectat inanis,</l>
  <l n="434"> et non sentitur sedulitate labor.</l>
  <l n="435"> haec implet lento calathos e vimine nexos,</l>
  <l n="436"> haec gremium, laxos degravat illa sinus;</l>
  <l n="437"> illa legit <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">calthas</name>, huic sunt <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">violaria</name> curae,</l>
  <l n="438"> illa <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">papavereas</name> subsecat ungue comas;</l>
  <l n="439"> has, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">hyacinthe</name>, tenes; illas, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">amarante</name>, moraris;</l>
  <l n="440"> pars <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">thyma</name>, pars <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">rhoean</name> et <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">meliloton</name> amat;</l>
  <l n="441"> plurima lecta <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">rosa</name> est, sunt et sine nomine flores:</l>
  <l n="442"> ipsa <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">crocos</name> tenues <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">liliaque</name> alba legit.</l>
  <l n="443"> carpendi studio paulatim longius itur,</l>
  <l n="444"> et dominam casu nulla secuta <name type="deity">comes</name>.</l>
  <l n="445"> hanc videt et visam patruus velociter aufert</l>
  <l n="446"> regnaque caeruleis in sua portat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
  <l n="427"> illa quidem clamabat 'io, carissima <name type="deity">mater</name>,</l>
  <l n="448"> auferor!', ipsa suos abscideratque sinus:</l>
  <l n="449"> panditur interea <name type="deity">Diti</name> via, namque diurnum</l>
  <l n="450"> lumen inadsueti vix patiuntur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name>.</l>
  <l n="451"> at, chorus aequalis, cumulatae flore ministrae</l>
  <l n="452"> '<name type="deity">Persephone</name>', clamant 'ad tua dona veni.'</l>
  <l n="453"> ut clamata silet, montes ululatibus implent,</l>
  <l n="454"> et feriunt maesta pectora nuda manu.</l>
  <l n="455"> attonita est plangore <name type="deity">Ceres</name> (modo venerat <placeName>Hennam</placeName>)</l>
  <l n="456"> nec mora, 'me miseram! <name type="deity">filia</name>' dixit 'ubi es?'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.18:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="457">mentis inops rapitur, quales audire solemus</l>
  <l n="458"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Threicias</name> fusis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">maenadas</name> ire comis.</l>
  <l n="459">ut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vitulo</name> mugit sua mater ab ubere rapto</l>
  <l n="460">et quaerit fetus per nemus omne suos,</l>
  <l n="461">sic dea nec retinet gemitus, et concita cursu</l>
  <l n="462">fertur, et e campis incipit, <placeName>Henna</placeName>, tuis.</l>
  <l n="463">inde puellaris nacta est vestigia plantae</l>
  <l n="464">et pressam noto pondere vidit humum;</l>
  <l n="465">forsitan illa dies erroris summa fuisset,</l>
  <l n="466">si non turbassent signa reperta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sues</name>.</l>
  <l n="467">iamque <placeName>Leontinos</placeName> <placeName>Amenana</placeName>que flumina cursu</l>
  <l n="468">praeterit et ripas, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbifer</name> <placeName>Aci</placeName>, tuas:</l>
  <l n="469">praeterit et <placeName>Cyanen</placeName> et fontes lenis <placeName>Anapi</placeName></l>
  <l n="470">et te, verticibus non adeunde <placeName>Gela</placeName>.</l>
  <l n="471">liquerat <placeName>Ortygien</placeName> <placeName>Megarea</placeName>que <placeName>Pantagien</placeName>que,</l>
  <l n="472">quaque <placeName>Symaetheas</placeName> accipit aequor aquas,</l>
  <l n="473">antraque <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Cyclopum</name> positis exusta caminis,</l>
  <l n="474">quique locus curvae nomina falcis habet,</l>
  <l n="475">Himeraque et Didymen Acragantaque Tauromenumque,</l>
  <l n="476"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">sacrarum</name>que <placeName>Mylas</placeName> pascua laeta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">boum</name>:</l>
  <l n="477">hinc <placeName>Camerinan</placeName> adit <placeName>Thapson</placeName>que et <placeName>Heloria</placeName> tempe,</l>
  <l n="478">quaque iacet <persName>Zephyro</persName> semper apertus <placeName>Eryx</placeName>.</l>
  <l n="479">iamque <placeName>Peloriadem</placeName> <placeName>Lilybaeaque</placeName>, iamque <placeName>Pachynon</placeName></l>
  <l n="480">lustrarat, terrae cornua prima suae:</l>
  <l n="481">quacumque ingreditur, miseris loca cuncta querellis</l>
  <l n="482">implet, ut amissum cum gemit ales <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Ityn</name>.</l>
  <l n="483">perque vices modo 'Persephone!' modo 'filia!' clamat,</l>
  <l n="484">clamat et alternis nomen utrumque ciet;</l>
  <l n="485">sed neque <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Persephone</name> <persName>Cerem</persName> nec filia matrem</l>
  <l n="486">audit, et alternis nomen utrumque perit;</l>
  <l n="487">unaque, pastorem vidisset an arva colentem,</l>
  <l n="488">vox erat 'hac gressus ecqua puella tulit?'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.19:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="490">iam color unus inest rebus tenebrisque teguntur</l>
  <l n="491"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>:    </l>
  <l n="492">alta iacet vasti super ora <name type="deity">Typhoeos</name> <placeName>Aetne</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="493">cuius anhelatis ignibus ardet humus;</l>
  <l n="494">illic accendit geminas pro lampade <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pinos</name>:</l>
  <l n="495">hinc <persName>Cereris</persName> sacris nunc quoque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">taeda</name> datur.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="496">est specus exesi structura <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pumicis</name> asper,</l>
  <l n="497">non homini regio, non adeunda <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">fera</name>:</l>
  <l n="498">quo simul ac venit, frenatos curribus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">angues</name></l>
  <l n="499">iungit et aequoreas sicca pererrat aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="500">effugit et <placeName>Syrtes</placeName> et te, <placeName>Zanclaea</placeName> <persName>Charybdi</persName>,</l>
  <l n="501">et vos, <persName>Nisei</persName>, naufraga monstra, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>,</l>
  <l n="502"><placeName>Hadriacum</placeName>que patens late bimaremque <placeName>Corinthum</placeName>:</l>
  <l n="503">sic venit ad portus, <placeName>Attica</placeName> terra, tuos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="504">hic primum sedit gelido maestissima saxo:</l>
  <l n="505">illud <persName>Cecropidae</persName> nunc quoque triste vocant.</l>
  <l n="506">sub <persName>Iove</persName> duravit multis immota diebus,</l>
  <l n="507">et <persName>lunae</persName> patiens et pluvialis aquae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="508">sors sua cuique loco est: quod nunc <persName>Cerialis</persName> <placeName>Eleusin</placeName></l>
  <l n="509">dicitur, hoc <persName>Cei</persName> rura fuere senis.</l>
  <l n="510">ille domum glandes excussaque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">mora</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">rubetis</name></l>
  <l n="511">portat et arsuris arida ligna focis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="512">filia parva duas redigebat monte <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">capellas</name>,</l>
  <l n="513">et tener in cunis filius aeger erat.</l>
  <l n="514">'mater' ait virgo (mota est dea nomine matris),</l>
  <l n="515">'quid facis in solis incomitata locis?'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="516">perstitit et senior, quamvis onus urget, et orat</l>
  <l n="517">tecta suae subeat quantulacumque casae.</l>
  <l n="518">illa negat (simularat anum mitraque capillos</l>
  <l n="519">presserat); instanti talia dicta refert:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="520">'sospes eas semperque parens; mihi filia rapta est.</l>
  <l n="521">heu, melior quanto sors tua sorte mea est!'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.20:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="521">dixit, et ut lacrimae (neque enim lacrimare deorum est)</l>
  <l n="522">decidit in tepidos lucida gutta sinus.</l>
  <l n="523">flent pariter molles animis virgoque senexque;</l>
  <l n="524">e quibus haec iusti verba fuere senis:</l>
  <l n="525"> 'sic tibi, quam raptam quaeris, sit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">filia</name> sospes;</l>
  <l n="526"> surge, nec exiguae despice tecta casae.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="527">cui dea 'duc' inquit; 'scisti qua cogere posses',</l>
  <l n="528">seque levat saxo subsequiturque senem.</l>
  <l n="529">dux comiti narrat quam sit sibi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">filius</name> aeger,</l>
  <l n="530">nec capiat somnos invigiletque malis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="531">illa soporiferum, parvos initura penates,</l>
  <l n="532">colligit agresti lene <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">papaver</name> humo.</l>
  <l n="533">dum legit, oblito fertur gustasse palato</l>
  <l n="534">longamque imprudens exsoluisse famem;</l>
  <l n="535">quae quia principio posuit ieiunia noctis,</l>
  <l n="536">tempus habent mystae sidera visa cibi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="537">limen ut intravit, luctus videt omnia plena;</l>
  <l n="538">iam spes in puero nulla salutis erat.</l>
  <l n="539">matre salutata (mater <persName>Metanira</persName> vocatur)</l>
  <l n="540">iungere dignata est os puerile suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="541">pallor abit, subitasque vident in corpore vires:</l>
  <l n="542">tantus caelesti venit ab ore vigor.</l>
  <l n="543">tota domus laeta est, hoc est, materque paterque</l>
  <l n="544">nataque: tres illi tota fuere domus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="545">mox epulas ponunt, liquefacta coagula lacte</l>
  <l n="546">pomaque et in ceris aurea mella suis.</l>
  <l n="547">abstinet alma <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Ceres</name>, somnique <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">papavera</name> causas</l>
  <l n="548">dat tibi cum tepido lacte bibenda, puer.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="549">noctis erat medium placidique silentia somni:</l>
  <l n="550">Triptolemum gremio sustulit illa suo,</l>
  <l n="551">terque manu permulsit eum, tria carmina dixit,</l>
  <l n="552">carmina mortali non referenda sono,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.21:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="553">inque foco corpus pueri vivente favilla</l>
  <l n="554">obruit, humanum purget ut ignis onus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="555">excutitur somno stulte pia mater, et amens</l>
  <l n="556">'quid facis?' exclamat, membraque ab igne rapit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="557">cui dea 'dum non es', dixit 'scelerata fuisti:</l>
  <l n="558">inrita materno sunt mea dona metu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="559">iste quidem mortalis erit: sed primus arabit</l>
  <l n="560">et seret et culta praemia tollet humo.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="561">dixit et egrediens nubem trahit, inque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">dracones</name></l>
  <l n="562">transit et aligero tollitur axe <name type="deity">Ceres</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="563"><placeName>Sunion</placeName> expositum <placeName>Piraeaque</placeName> tuta recessu</l>
  <l n="564">linquit et in dextrum quae iacet ora latus;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="565">hinc init <placeName>Aegaeum</placeName>, quo <placeName>Cycladas</placeName> aspicit omnes,</l>
  <l n="566"><placeName>Ioniumque</placeName> rapax <placeName>Icariumque</placeName> legit,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="567">perque urbes <placeName>Asiae</placeName> longum petit <placeName>Hellespontum</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="568">diversumque locis alta pererrat iter.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="559">nam modo turilegos <persName>Arabas</persName>, modo despicit <persName>Indos</persName>;</l>
  <l n="570">hinc <placeName>Libys</placeName>, hinc <placeName>Meroe</placeName> siccaque terra subest;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="571">nunc adit <persName>Hesperios</persName>, <placeName>Rhenum</placeName> <placeName>Rhodanumque</placeName> <placeName>Padumque</placeName></l>
  <l n="572">teque, future parens, <placeName>Thybri</placeName>, potentis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="573">quo feror? immensum est erratas dicere terras:</l>
  <l n="574">praeteritus <name type="deity">Cereri</name> nullus in orbe locus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="575">errat et in caelo, liquidique immunia ponti</l>
  <l n="576">adloquitur gelido proxima signa polo:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="577">'<persName>Parrhasides</persName> stellae, namque omnia nosse potestis,</l>
  <l n="578">aequoreas numquam cum subeatis aquas,</l>
  <l n="579"><persName>Persephonen</persName> natam miserae monstrate parenti.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="580">dixerat. huic <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Helice</name> talia verba refert:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="581">'crimine nox vacua est; <name type="deity">Solem</name> de virgine rapta</l>
  <l n="582">consule, qui late facta diurna videt.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="583"><name type="deity">Sol</name> aditus 'quam quaeris', ait 'ne vana labores,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.22:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="584">nupta <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovis</name> fratri tertia regna tenet.'</l>
  <l n="585">questa diu secum, sic est adfata <persName>Tonantem</persName></l>
  <l n="586">(maximaque in voltu signa dolentis erant):</l>
  <l n="587">'si memor es de quo mihi sit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Proserpina</name> nata,</l>
  <l n="588">dimidium curae debet habere tuae.</l>
  <l n="589">orbe pererrato sola est iniuria facti</l>
  <l n="590">cognita: commissi praemia raptor habet.</l>
  <l n="591">at neque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Persephone</name> digna est praedone marito,</l>
  <l n="592">nec gener hoc nobis more parandus erat.</l>
  <l n="593">quid gravius victore <foreign xml:lang="la">Gyge</foreign> captiva tulissem</l>
  <l n="594">quam nunc te caeli sceptra tenente tuli?</l>
  <l n="595">verum impune ferat, nos haec patiemur inultae;</l>
  <l n="596">reddat et emendet facta priora novis.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="597"><persName>Iuppiter</persName> hanc lenit, factumque excusat amore,</l>
  <l n="598">nec gener est nobis ille pudendus ait;</l>
  <l n="599">'non ego nobilior: posita est mihi regia caelo,</l>
  <l n="600">possidet alter aquas, alter inane chaos.</l>
  <l n="601">sed si forte tibi non est mutabile pectus,</l>
  <l n="602">statque semel iuncti rumpere vincla tori,</l>
  <l n="603">hoc quoque temptemus, siquidem ieiuna remansit;</l>
  <l n="604">si minus, inferni coniugis uxor erit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="605"><placeName>Tartara</placeName> iussus adit sumptis <persName>Caducifer</persName> alis,</l>
  <l n="606">speque redit citius visaque certa refert:</l>
  <l n="607">'rapta tribus' dixit 'solvit ieiunia granis,</l>
  <l n="608"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Punica</name> quae lento cortice poma tegunt.'</l>
  <l n="609">non secus indoluit quam si modo rapta fuisset</l>
  <l n="610">maesta parens, longa vixque refecta mora est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="611">atque ita 'nec nobis caelum est habitabile' dixit;</l>
  <l n="612"><placeName>Taenaria</placeName> recipi me quoque valle iube.'</l>
  <l n="613">et factura fuit, pactus nisi <persName>Iuppiter</persName> esset</l>
  <l n="614">bis tribus ut caelo mensibus illa foret.</l>
  <l n="615">tum demum voltumque <persName>Ceres</persName> animumque recepit,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.23:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="618">imposuitque suae <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">spicea</name> serta <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">comae</name>:</l>
  <l n="619">largaque provenit cessatis messis in <name type="placeName">arvis</name>,</l>
  <l n="620">et vix congestas area cepit opes.</l>
  <l n="621"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">alba</name> decent <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Cererem</name>: vestes <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Cerialibus</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">albas</name></l>
  <l n="622">sumite; nunc <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pulli</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">velleris</name> usus abest.</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <head>13. G EID : NP</head>
  <l n="623">Occupat <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Apriles</name> <name type="placeName">Idus</name> cognomine <persName>Victor</persName></l>
  <l n="624"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iuppiter</name>: hac illi sunt data templa die.</l>
  <l n="625">hac quoque, ni fallor, populo dignissima nostro</l>
  <l n="626">atria <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Libertas</name> coepit habere sua.</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <head>14. HN</head>
  <l n="627">Luce secutura tutos pete, <persName>navita</persName>, portus:</l>
  <l n="628">ventus ab <name type="placeName">occasu</name> grandine mixtus erit.</l>
  <l n="629">scilicet ut fuerit, tamen hac <name type="placeName">Mutinensia</name> <persName>Caesar</persName></l>
  <l n="630">grandine militia perculit arma sua.</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <head>15. A FORD : NP 16. BN</head>
</lg>
morceaux.24:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="631">Tertia post <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Veneris</name> cum lux surrexerit Idus,</l>
  <l n="632">pontifices, forda sacra litate <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bove</name>.</l>
  <l n="633">forda ferens <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bos</name> est fecundaque dicta ferendo:</l>
  <l n="634">hinc etiam fetus nomen habere putant.</l>
  <l n="635">nunc gravidum pecus est, gravidae quoque semine terrae:</l>
  <l n="636"><name type="placeName">Telluri</name> plenae victima plena datur.</l>
  <l n="637">pars cadit arce <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovis</name>, ter denas curia vaccas</l>
  <l n="638">accipit et largo sparsa cruore madet.</l>
  <l n="639">ast ubi visceribus vitulos rapuere ministri,</l>
  <l n="640">sectaque fumosis exta dedere focis,</l>
  <l n="641">igne cremat vitulos quae natu maxima <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Virgo</name> est,</l>
  <l n="642">luce <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Palis</name> populos purget ut ille cinis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="643">rege <persName>Numa</persName>, fructu non respondente labori,</l>
  <l n="644">inrita decepti vota colentis erant.</l>
  <l n="645">nam modo siccus erat gelidis <foreign xml:lang="la">Aquilonibus</foreign> annus,</l>
  <l n="646">nunc ager assidua luxuriabat aqua;</l>
  <l n="647">saepe <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Ceres</name> primis dominum fallebat in <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbis</name>,</l>
  <l n="648">et levis obsesso stabat <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">avena</name> solo,</l>
  <l n="649">et pecus ante diem partus edebat acerbos,</l>
  <l n="650">agnaque nascendo saepe necabat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovem</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="651">silva vetus nullaque diu violata securi</l>
  <l n="652">stabat, <name type="placeName">Maenalio</name> sacra relicta deo:</l>
  <l n="653">ille dabat tacitis animo responsa quieto</l>
  <l n="654">noctibus; hic geminas rex <persName>Numa</persName> mactat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">oves</name>.</l>
  <l n="655">prima cadit <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fauno</name>, leni cadit altera <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Somno</name>;</l>
  <l n="656">sternitur in duro vellus utrumque solo.</l>
  <l n="657">bis caput intonsum fontana spargitur unda,</l>
  <l n="658">bis sua faginea tempora fronde premit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="659">usus abest <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Veneris</name>, nec fas <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">animalia</name> mensis</l>
  <l n="660">ponere, nec digitis anulus ullus inest;</l>
  <l n="661">veste rudi tectus supra nova vellera corpus</l>
  <l n="662">ponit, adorato per sua verba deo.</l>
  <l n="663">interea placidam redimita <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">papavere</name> frontem</l>
</lg>
morceaux.25:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="661">Nox venit, et secum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">somnia</name> nigra trahit;</l>
  <l n="662"><persName>Faunus</persName> adest, oviumque premens pede vellera duro</l>
  <l n="663">edidit a dextro talia verba toro:</l>
  <l n="664"> 'morte boum tibi, rex, <name type="deity">Tellus</name> placanda duarum:</l>
  <l n="665"> det sacris animas una <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">iuvenca</name> duas.'</l>
  <l n="666"> excutitur terrore quies: <persName>Numa</persName> visa revolvit,</l>
  <l n="667"> et secum ambages caecaque iussa refert.</l>
  <l n="668"> expedit errantem nemori gratissima coniunx</l>
  <l n="669"> et dixit 'gravidae posceris exta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bovis</name>.'</l>
  <l n="670"> exta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bovis</name> gravidae dantur; fecundior annus</l>
  <l n="671"> provenit, et fructum terra pecusque ferunt.</l>
  <l n="672"> Hanc quondam <name type="deity">Cytherea</name> diem properantius ire</l>
  <l n="673"> iussit et admissos praecipitavit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>,</l>
  <l n="674"> ut titulum imperii cum primum luce sequenti</l>
  <l n="675"> <persName>Augusto</persName> iuveni prospera bella darent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="676">Sed iam praeteritas quartus tibi <persName>Lucifer</persName> <foreign xml:lang="la">Idus</foreign></l>
  <l n="677"> respicit; hac <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Hyades</name> <name type="deity">Dorida</name> nocte tenent.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.26:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Tertia post <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Hyadas</name> cum lux erit orta remotas,</l>
  <l n="2">carcere partitos Circus habebit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>.</l>
  <l n="3">cur igitur missae vinctis ardentia taedis</l>
  <l n="4">terga ferant <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volpes</name> causa docenda mihi est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">frigida <placeName>Carseolis</placeName> nec <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">olivis</name> apta ferendis</l>
  <l n="6">terra, sed ad segetes ingeniosus ager;</l>
  <l n="7">hac ego <placeName>Paelignos</placeName>, natalia rura, petebam,</l>
  <l n="8">parva, sed assiduis obvia semper <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">hospitis antiqui solitas intravimus aedes;</l>
  <l n="10">dempserat emeritis iam iuga <name type="deity">Phoebus</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
  <l n="11">is mihi multa quidem, sed et haec narrare solebat,</l>
  <l n="12">unde meum praesens instrueretur opus:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">'hoc' ait 'in campo' (<foreign xml:lang="la">campumque</foreign> ostendit) 'habebat</l>
  <l n="14">rus breve cum duro parca colona viro.</l>
  <l n="15">ille suam peragebat humum, sive usus aratri,</l>
  <l n="16">seu curvae falcis, seu bidentis erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">haec modo verrebat stantem tibicine villam,</l>
  <l n="18">nunc matris plumis ova fovenda dabat,</l>
  <l n="19">aut <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">virides</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">malvas</name> aut <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">fungos</name> colligit albos</l>
  <l n="20">aut humilem grato calfacit igne focum;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">et tamen assiduis exercet bracchia telis,</l>
  <l n="22">adversusque minas frigoris arma parat.</l>
  <l n="23">filius huius erat primo lascivus in aevo,</l>
  <l n="24">addideratque annos ad duo lustra duos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">is capit extremi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volpem</name> convalle <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">salicti</name>:</l>
  <l n="26">abstulerat multas illa cohortis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aves</name>.</l>
  <l n="27">captivam stipula fenoque involvit et ignes</l>
  <l n="28">admovet: urentes effugit illa manus:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">qua fugit, incendit vestitos <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">messibus</name> agros;</l>
  <l n="30">damnosis vires ignibus aura dabat.</l>
  <l n="31">factum abiit, monimenta manent: ~nam dicere certam~</l>
  <l n="32">nunc quoque lex <placeName>Carseolana</placeName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volpem</name> vetat,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.27:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">utque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">luat</name> poenas, gens haec <name type="deity">Cerialibus</name> ardet,</l>
  <l n="2">quoque modo <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">segetes</name> perdidit ipsa perit.'</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20">FN</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Proxima cum veniet terras visura patentes</l>
  <l n="2"><name type="deity">Memnonis</name> in <foreign xml:lang="la">roseis</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">lutea</foreign> mater <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>,</l>
  <l n="3">de duce <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lanigeri</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecoris</name>, qui prodidit <persName>Hellen</persName>,</l>
  <l n="4"><name type="deity">sol</name> abit: egresso victima maior adest.</l>
  <l n="5"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vacca</name> sit an <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurus</name> non est cognoscere promptum:</l>
  <l n="6">pars prior apparet, posteriora latent.</l>
  <l n="7">seu tamen est <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurus</name> sive est hoc <foreign xml:lang="la">femina</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">signum</foreign>,</l>
  <l n="8"><name type="deity">Iunone</name> invita munus <foreign xml:lang="la">amoris</foreign> habet.</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">G PAR : NP</l>
</lg>
morceaux.28:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="721">Nox abiit, oriturque aurora: Parilia poscor;</l>
  <l n="722">non poscor frustra, si favet <name type="deity">alma Pales</name>.</l>
  <l n="723"><name type="deity">alma Pales</name>, faveas pastoria sacra canenti,</l>
  <l n="724">prosequor officio si tua festa meo.</l>
  <l n="725">certe ego de <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vitulo</name> cinerem stipulasque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">fabales</name></l>
  <l n="726">saepe tuli plena, februa tosta, manu;</l>
  <l n="727">certe ego transilui positas ter in ordine flammas,</l>
  <l n="728">udaque roratas <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">laurea</name> misit aquas.</l>
  <l n="729">mota <name type="deity">dea</name> est, operique favet. navalibus exit</l>
  <l n="730">puppis; habent ventos iam mea vela suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="731">i, pete virginea, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">populus</name>, suffimen ab ara;</l>
  <l n="732"><name type="deity">Vesta</name> dabit, <name type="deity">Vestae</name> munere purus eris.</l>
  <l n="733"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sanguis</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name> suffimen erit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vitulique</name> favilla,</l>
  <l n="734">tertia res durae culmen inane <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">fabae</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="735">pastor, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">oves</name> saturas ad prima crepuscula lustra:</l>
  <l n="736">unda prius spargat, virgaque verrat humum;</l>
  <l n="737">frondibus et fixis decorentur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovilia</name> ramis,</l>
  <l n="738">et tegat ornatas longa corona fores.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="739">caerulei fiant puro de <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">sulpure</name> fumi,</l>
  <l n="740">tactaque fumanti <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">sulpure</name> balet <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="741">ure <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">mares</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">oleas</name> taedamque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbasque</name> <foreign xml:lang="la">Sabinas</foreign>,</l>
  <l n="72">et crepet in mediis <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">laurus</name> adusta focis;</l>
  <l n="743">libaque de <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">milio</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">milii</name> fiscella sequatur:</l>
  <l n="744">rustica praecipue est <name type="deity">dea</name> laeta cibo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="745">adde dapes mulctramque suas, dapibusque resectis</l>
  <l n="746">silvicolam tepido lacte precare <name type="deity">Palem</name>.</l>
  <l n="747">'consule' dic 'pecori pariter pecorisque magistris:</l>
  <l n="748">effugiat stabulis noxa repulsa meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="749">sive sacro pavi, sedive sub arbore sacra,</l>
  <l n="750">pabulaque e bustis inscia carpsit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovis</name>;</l>
  <l n="751">si nemus intravi vetitum, nostrisve fugatae</l>
  <l n="752">sunt oculis nymphae semicaperque <name type="deity">deus</name>;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.29:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="753">si mea falx ramo lucum spoliavit opaco,</l>
  <l n="754">unde data est aegrae <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">fiscina</name> frondis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovi</name>,</l>
  <l n="755">da veniam culpae: nec, dum degrandinat, obsit</l>
  <l n="756">agresti <placeName>fano</placeName> subposuisse <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecus</name>.</l>
  <l n="757">nec noceat turbasse <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lacus</name>: ignoscite, <name type="deity">nymphae</name>,</l>
  <l n="758">mota quod obscuras ungula fecit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquas</name>.</l>
  <l n="759">tu, <name type="deity">dea</name>, pro nobis fontes fontanaque placa</l>
  <l n="760">numina, tu sparsos per nemus omne <name type="deity">deos</name>.</l>
  <l n="761">nec <name type="deity">dryadas</name> nec nos videamus labra <name type="deity">Dianae</name></l>
  <l n="762">nec <name type="deity">Faunum</name>, medio cum premit arva die.</l>
  <l n="763">pelle procul morbos; valeant hominesque gregesque,</l>
  <l n="764">et valeant vigiles, provida turba, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>.</l>
  <l n="765">neve minus multos redigam quam mane fuerunt,</l>
  <l n="766">neve gemam referens vellera rapta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupo</name>.</l>
  <l n="767">absit iniqua <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">fames</name>: <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbae</name> frondesque supersint,</l>
  <l n="768">quaeque lavent artus quaeque bibantur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>.</l>
  <l n="769">ubera plena premam, referat mihi caseus aera,</l>
  <l n="770">dentque viam liquido vimina rara <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sero</name>;</l>
  <l n="771">sitque salax <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aries</name>, conceptaque semina coniunx</l>
  <l n="772">reddat, et in stabulo multa sit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">agna</name> meo;</l>
  <l n="773">lanaque proveniat nullas laesura puellas,</l>
  <l n="774">mollis et ad teneras quamlibet apta manus.</l>
  <l n="775">quae precor, eveniant, et nos faciamus ad annum</l>
  <l n="776">pastorum dominae grandia liba <name type="deity">Pali</name>.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="777">his dea placanda est: haec tu conversus ad ortus</l>
  <l n="778">dic quater et vivo perlue rore manus.</l>
  <l n="779">tum licet adposita, veluti cratere, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">camella</name></l>
  <l n="780">lac niveum potes purpureamque sapam;</l>
  <l n="781">moxque per ardentes stipulae crepitantis acervos</l>
  <l n="782">traicias celeri strenua membra pede.</l>
  <l n="783">expositus mos est; moris mihi restat origo:</l>
  <l n="784">turba facit dubium coeptaque nostra tenet.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.30:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="785">omnia purgat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">edax</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ignis</name> vitiumque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">metallis</name></l>
  <l n="786">excoquit: idcirco cum duce purgat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">oves</name>?</l>
  <l n="787">an, quia cunctarum contraria semina rerum</l>
  <l n="788">sunt duo discordes, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ignis</name> et unda, dei,</l>
  <l n="789">iunxerunt elementa patres, aptumque putarunt</l>
  <l n="790">ignibus et sparsa tangere corpus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aqua</name>?</l>
  <l n="791">an, quod in his vitae causa est, haec perdidit exul,</l>
  <l n="792">his nova fit coniunx, haec duo magna putant?</l>
  <l n="793">vix equidem credo: sunt qui <persName>Phaethonta</persName> referri</l>
  <l n="794">credant et nimias <persName>Deucalionis</persName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquas</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="795">pars quoque, cum saxis pastores saxa feribant,</l>
  <l n="796">scintillam subito prosiluisse ferunt;</l>
  <l n="797">prima quidem periit, stipulis excepta secunda est:</l>
  <l n="798">hoc argumentum <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">flamma</name> <persName>Parilis</persName> habet?</l>
  <l n="799">an magis hunc morem <persName>Aeneia</persName> pietas fecit,</l>
  <l n="800">innocuum victo cui dedit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ignis</name> iter?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="801">num tamen est vero propius, cum condita <placeName>Roma</placeName> est,</l>
  <l n="802">transferri iussos in nova tecta <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Lares</name>,</l>
  <l n="803">mutantesque domum tectis agrestibus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ignem</name></l>
  <l n="804">et cessaturae subposuisse casae,</l>
  <l n="805">per flammas saluisse <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecus</name>, saluisse colonos?</l>
  <l n="806">quod fit natali nunc quoque, <placeName>Roma</placeName>, tuo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="807">ipse locum casus vati facit: <placeName>Urbis</placeName> origo</l>
  <l n="808">venit; ades factis, magne <persName>Quirine</persName>, tuis.</l>
  <l n="809">iam luerat poenas frater <persName>Numitoris</persName>, et omne</l>
  <l n="810">pastorum gemino sub duce volgus erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="811">contrahere agrestes et moenia ponere utrique</l>
  <l n="812">convenit: ambigitur moenia ponat uter.</l>
  <l n="813">'nil opus est' dixit 'certamine' <persName>Romulus</persName> 'ullo;</l>
  <l n="814">magna fides avium est: experiamur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aves</name>.'</l>
  <l n="815">res placet: alter init nemorosi saxa <placeName>Palati</placeName>;</l>
  <l n="816">alter <placeName>Aventinum</placeName> mane cacumen init.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.31:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="817">sex Remus, hic <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volucres</name> bis sex videt ordine; pacto</l>
  <l n="818">statur, et arbitrium Romulus <placeName>urbis</placeName> habet.</l>
  <l n="819">apta dies legitur qua moenia signet aratro:</l>
  <l n="820">sacra Palis suberant; inde movetur opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="821">fossa fit ad solidum, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">fruges</name> iaciuntur in ima</l>
  <l n="822">et de vicino terra petita solo;</l>
  <l n="823">fossa repletur humo, plenaeque imponitur ara,</l>
  <l n="824">et novus accenso fungitur igne focus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="825">inde premens stivam designat moenia sulco;</l>
  <l n="826"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">alba</name> iugum niveo cum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bove</name> vacca tulit.</l>
  <l n="827">vox fuit haec regis: 'condenti, <name type="deity">Iuppiter</name>,</l>
  <l n="828">et genitor <name type="deity">Mavors</name> <name type="deity">Vestaque</name> mater, ades,</l>
  <l n="829">quosque pium est adhibere deos, advertite cuncti:</l>
  <l n="830">auspicibus vobis hoc mihi surgat opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="831">longa sit huic aetas dominaeque potentia terrae,</l>
  <l n="832">sitque sub hac oriens occiduusque dies.'</l>
  <l n="833">ille precabatur, tonitru dedit omina laevo</l>
  <l n="834"><name type="deity">Iuppiter</name>, et laevo fulmina missa polo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="835">augurio laeti iaciunt fundamina cives,</l>
  <l n="836">et novus exiguo tempore murus erat.</l>
  <l n="837">hoc <persName>Celer</persName> urget opus, quem <persName>Romulus</persName> ipse vocarat,</l>
  <l n="838">'sint' que, 'Celer, curae' dixerat 'ista tuae,</l>
  <l n="839">neve quis aut muros aut factam vomere fossam</l>
  <l n="840">transeat; audentem talia dede neci.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="841">quod <persName>Remus</persName> ignorans humiles contemnere muros</l>
  <l n="842">coepit, et 'his populus' dicere 'tutus erit?'</l>
  <l n="843">nec mora, transiluit: rutro <persName>Celer</persName> occupat ausum;</l>
  <l n="844">ille premit duram sanguinulentus humum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="845">haec ubi rex didicit, lacrimas introrsus obortas</l>
  <l n="846">devorat et clausum pectore volnus habet.</l>
  <l n="847">flere palam non volt exemplaque fortia servat,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.32:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="848">‘sic’ que ‘meos muros transeat hostis’ ait.</l>
  <l n="849">dat tamen exsequias; nec iam suspendere fletum</l>
  <l n="850">sustinet, et pietas dissimulata patet;</l>
  <l n="851">osculaque adplicuit posito suprema feretro,</l>
  <l n="852">atque ait ‘invito frater adempte, vale’,</l>
  <l n="853">arsurosque artus unxit: fecere, quod ille,</l>
  <l n="854">Faustulus et maestas Acca soluta comas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="855">tum iuvenem nondum facti flevere Quirites;</l>
  <l n="856">ultima plorato subdita flamma rogo est.</l>
  <l n="857">urbs oritur (quis tunc hoc ulli credere posset?)</l>
  <l n="858">victorem terris impositura pedem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="859">cuncta regas et sis magno sub Caesare semper,</l>
  <l n="860">saepe etiam plures nominis hius habe;</l>
  <l n="861">et, quotiens steteris domito sublimis in orbe,</l>
  <l n="862">omnia sint umeris inferiora tuis.</l>
</lg>

morceaux.33: Halieutica Dicta Pales nobis: idem Vinalia dicam. una tamen media est inter utramque dies. numina, volgares, Veneris celebrate, puellae: multa professarum quaestibus apta Venus. poscite ture dato formam populique favorem, poscite blanditias dignaque verba ioco; cumque sua dominae date grata sisymbria myrto tectaque composita iuncea vincla rosa. templa frequentari Collinae proxima portae nunc decet; a Siculo nomina colle tenent, utque Syracusas Arethusidas abstulit armis Claudius et bello te quoque cepit, Eryx, carmine vivacis Venus est translata Sibyllae, inque suae stirpis maluit urbe coli. cur igitur Veneris festum Vinalia dicant quaeritis, et quare sit Iovis ista dies? Turnus an Aeneas Latiae gener esset Amatae bellum erat: Etruscas Turnus adorat opes. clarus erat sumptisque ferox Mezentius armis, et vel equo magnus vel pede maior erat; quem Rutuli Turnusque suis adsciscere temptat partibus. haec contra dux ita Tuscus ait: 'stat mihi non parvo virtus mea: volnera testor armaque, quae sparsi sanguine saepe meo. qui petis auxilium, non grandia divide mecum praemia, de lacubus proxima musta tuis. nulla mora est operae: vestrum est dare, vincere nostrum. quam velit Aeneas ista negata mihi!' adnuerant Rutuli. Mezentius induit arma, induit Aeneas adloquiturque Iovem: hostica Tyrrheno vota est vindemia regi: Iuppiter, e Latio palmite musta feres.'
morceaux.34:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="895">vota valent meliora: cadit <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Mezentius</name> ingens</l>
  <l n="896">atque indignanti pectore plangit humum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="897">venerat <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Autumnus</name> calcatis sordidus uvis:</l>
  <l n="898">redduntur merito debita vina <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovi</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="899">dicta dies hinc est <head>Vinalia</head>; <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iuppiter</name> illa</l>
  <l n="900">vindicat, et festis gaudet inesse suis.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.35:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="901">Sex ubi, quae restant, luces <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Aprilis</name> habebit,</l>
  <l n="902">in medio cursu tempora <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">veris</name> erunt,</l>
  <l n="903">et frustra <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecudem</name> quaeres <persName>Athamantidos</persName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Helles</name>,</l>
  <l n="904">signaque dant imbres, exoriturque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Canis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="905">hac mihi <placeName>Nomento</placeName> <persName>Romam</persName> cum luce redirem,</l>
  <l n="906">obstitit in media candida turba via:</l>
  <l n="907"><persName>flamen</persName> in antiquae <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Robiginis</name> ibat,</l>
  <l n="908"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">exta</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canis</name> flammis, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">exta</name> daturus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="909">protinus accessi, ritus ne nescius essem;</l>
  <l n="910">edidit haec <persName>flamen</persName> verba, <name type="deity">Quirine</name>, tuus:</l>
  <l n="911">'aspera <name type="deity">Robigo</name>, parcas <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Cerialibus</name> herbis,</l>
  <l n="912">et tremat in summa leve cacumen humo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="913">tu sata sideribus caeli nutrita secundi</l>
  <l n="914">crescere, dum fiant falcibus apta, sinas.</l>
  <l n="915">vis tua non levis est: quae tu frumenta notasti,</l>
  <l n="916">maestus in amissis illa colonus habet;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="917">nec venti tantum <persName>Cereris</persName> nocuere nec imbres,</l>
  <l n="918">nec sic marmoreo pallet adusta gelu,</l>
  <l n="919">quantum si culmos <persName>Titan</persName> incalfacit udos:</l>
  <l n="920">tum locus est irae, <name type="deity">diva</name> timenda, tuae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="921">parce, precor, scabrasque manus a messibus aufer,</l>
  <l n="922">neve noce cultis; posse nocere sat est.</l>
  <l n="923">nec teneras segetes, sed durum amplectere ferrum,</l>
  <l n="924">quodque potest alios perdere perde prior.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="925">utilius gladios et tela nocentia carpes:</l>
  <l n="926">nil opus est illis; otia mundus agit.</l>
  <l n="927">sarcula nunc durusque bidens et vomer aduncus,</l>
  <l n="928">ruris opes, niteant; inquinet arma situs,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="929">conatusque aliquis vagina ducere ferrum</l>
  <l n="930">adstrictum longa sentiat esse mora.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="931">at tu ne viola <persName>Cererem</persName>, semperque colonus</l>
  <l n="932">absenti possit solvere vota tibi.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="933">dixerat; a dextra villis mantele solutis</l>
</lg>
morceaux.36:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="934">cumque meri patera turis acerra fuit.</l>
  <l n="935">tura focis vinumque dedit fibrasque bidentis</l>
  <l n="936"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canis</name>.</l>
  <l n="937">turpiaque obscenae (vidimus) exta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canis</name>.</l>
  <l n="938">tum mihi 'cur detur sacris nova victima quaeris?'</l>
  <l n="939">(quaesieram) 'causam percipe' flamen ait.</l>
  <l n="940">'est <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Canis</name>, Icarium dicunt, quo sidere moto</l>
  <l n="941">tosta sitit tellus praecipiturque seges:</l>
  <l n="942">pro <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cane</name> sidereo <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canis</name> hic imponitur arae,</l>
  <l n="943">et quare fiat nil nisi nomen habet.'</l>
</lg>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="945">Cum Phrygis Assaraci Tithonia fratre relicto</l>
  <l n="946">sustulit immenso ter iubar orbe suum,</l>
  <l n="947">mille venit variis florum dea nexa coronis;</l>
  <l n="948">scaena ioci morem liberioris habet.</l>
  <l n="949">exit et in Maias sacrum Florale Kalendas:</l>
  <l n="950">tunc repetam, nunc me grandius urget opus.</l>
  <l n="951">aufer, <persName>Vesta</persName>, diem: cognati <persName>Vesta</persName> recepta est</l>
  <l n="952">limine; sic iusti constituere patres.</l>
  <l n="953"><name type="deity">Phoebus</name> habet partem: <persName>Vestae</persName> pars altera cessit:</l>
  <l n="954">quod superest illis, tertius ipse tenet.</l>
  <l n="955">state Palatinae laurus, praetextaque quercu</l>
  <l n="956">stet domus: aeternos tres habet una deos.</l>
</lg>
